escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via jest/ts-jest
escalations.summary: CVSS 9.8 arbitrary JavaScript execution during test compilation via crafted Handlebars templates. 8 CVEs including GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q (AST type confusion injection) and GHSA-2qvq-rjwj-gvw9 (prototype pollution XSS).
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm install jest@30+ ts-jest@latest --save-dev

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via OpenTelemetry
escalations.summary: CVSS 9.8 RCE via crafted OTLP trace data in OpenTelemetry exporter. 8 CVEs including GHSA-xq3m-2v4x-88gg (arbitrary code execution) and GHSA-66ff-xgx4-vchm (code injection via bytes field defaults). Root package 171 versions behind.

p1.title: FR-070 requirement ID collision between Plans/image-upload and Plans/orchestrator-cycle-dashboard
p1.detail: Two plans both assign FR-070 to unrelated features. Dependency-linking plan references FR-070-FR-085 in Specifications/ — those IDs do not exist there. Traceability integrity broken.
p1.recommendation: Renumber image-upload FRs to FR-IMG-001+, orchestrator-cycle FRs to FR-OCD-001+. Add PR gate blocking duplicate FR-NNN IDs.

p2.title: Traceability enforcer does not scan portal/ — PASSED result is meaningless for largest codebase
p2.detail: source_dirs = ['Source', 'E2E'] — portal/ (2× more code, 69+ FRs) invisible to enforcer

p2.title: FR-dependency-seed unimplemented — seed.ts missing from portal/Backend
p2.detail: 9 seeded dependency relationships required. Acceptance criterion GET /api/bugs/BUG-0010 returns 5 items will fail.

p2.title: UpdateBugInput/UpdateFeatureRequestInput missing blocked_by field — forces as any cast
p2.detail: Missing blocked_by?: string[] in portal/Shared/api.ts update types. Worked around with as any on DependencyPicker:291-293.
p2.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both update types. Remove as any casts.

p2.title: Silent .catch(() => {}) in 3 user-facing portal components
p2.detail: Empty catch blocks discard all errors. CLAUDE.md rule: Never swallow errors silently.
p2.recommendation: Replace with at-minimum .catch((err) => logger.warn({ err }, 'non-critical fetch failed')) or set UI error state.

p2.title: 39 extension FRs absent from Specifications/ — image upload, orchestrator dashboard, dup/deprecated status
p2.detail: FR-070..FR-095 and FR-DUP-01..FR-DUP-13 fully implemented but not in canonical spec. New agents will not see these features.
p2.recommendation: Append extension sections to Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md with non-colliding IDs.

p2.title: OTel Prometheus exporter crash on malformed HTTP requests — CVSS 7.5
p2.detail: Unauthenticated attacker can crash telemetry subsystem via malformed HTTP to metrics endpoint.

p2.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via many URL parameters — CVSS 7.5
p2.detail: Malicious URL with many parameters causes catastrophic backtracking in Express routing, blocking all requests.

p2.title: picomatch ReDoS via extglob quantifiers — CVSS 7.5
p2.detail: Glob pattern matching has ReDoS via @(...|...)* patterns in build tools and file watchers.

p3.title: Phantom FR-0001 references (x5) in DependencySection.tsx — no such ID exists
No test files for search.ts and teamDispatches.ts portal backend routes
p3.recommendation: Add test files covering empty query, keyword filter, partial match, no-results cases.

p3.title: 5 production files exceed 500-line threshold
p3.recommendation: Split detail components and client.ts into domain sub-modules.

p3.title: 4 eslint-disable suppressions — stale-closure risk in hooks
p3.recommendation: Restructure hooks or use useCallback. Use _next parameter in errorHandler.

p3.title: Vite path traversal in .map files — dev-mode only
esbuild dev server allows cross-origin requests — dev-only
Vitest/vite-node transitive CVEs
p3.recommendation: Bundled with Vite/Vitest stable release upgrade.

p4.title: FR-TMP-008 has no traceability anchor in platform/Dockerfile.worker
p4.recommendation: Add # Verifies: FR-TMP-008 near the gh CLI install section.

p4.title: DebugPortalPage uses free-text traceability description instead of FR-XXX ID
p4.recommendation: Create minimal plan entry FR-WF-014 or equivalent; update comment.
